title: Cobe.js
concept: Ferro Lund Arquitectos: a Lisbon studio's atlas of nine buildings in nine climates, on a limestone cobe globe whose oxide arcs run from the studio to each site; picking a project turns the globe to it and its anchored label lights up.
notes: cobe 2.0.1 (installed): no onRender in v2, so the page drives globe.update({phi, theta}) from its own rAF loop, paused offscreen (IntersectionObserver) and on hidden tabs; ResizeObserver feeds update({width, height}), DPR clamped to 2. Marker labels use cobe v2's id-bound CSS anchor positioning (--cobe-<id>, --cobe-visible-<id>) and are hidden where anchor positioning is unsupported. Drag (pointer/touch, pan-y kept) and arrow keys steer; reduced motion disables auto-orbit, easing and the SVG orbit dot. ?shot freezes the Atlantic pose.
